name: smam_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for SMAM subsidy authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: smam_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: smam_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for SMAM machinery subsidy based on land holding, category (general/SC-ST/women/small-marginal), and prior subsidy history. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer already received SMAM subsidy for same machinery category within the exclusion period, or if land records are unavailable.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_select_machinery
description: Selects a machinery type for subsidy application. Returns machinery details, subsidy rates, and cap limits. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if machinery_type unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_select_vendor
description: Selects an authorized vendor for machinery purchase. Vendor must be empanelled. Transitions vendor_status to 'selected'. Requires session_token. Does NOT purchase machinery. Fails if vendor_id invalid, vendor not authorized, or vendor not in farmer's region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates subsidy amount based on machinery type, cost, and beneficiary category. Subsidy is a percentage with upper cap. Returns farmer's share and subsidy breakdown. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse. Fails if machinery cost invalid or category mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_submit_application
description: Submits SMAM subsidy application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Farmer must be eligible and vendor selected. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or vendor not selected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_verify_purchase
description: Verifies that machinery has been purchased from the authorized vendor with valid invoice. Transitions purchase_status to 'verified'. Application must be approved. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if invoice-application mismatch, vendor not authorized, or application not approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_track_subsidy
description: Tracks subsidy_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'approved', 'disbursed', 'failed'). Subsidy released only after purchase verification and inspection. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate. Fails if purchase not verified.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_get_vendor_list
description: Returns list of authorized vendors for a machinery type in a region. Requires session_token. Does NOT select vendor. Fails if no vendors found.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_get_machinery_details
description: Returns detailed info about a machinery type including specs, price range, and subsidy rates. Requires session_token. Does NOT select or purchase. Fails if type unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_schedule_inspection
description: Schedules physical inspection of purchased machinery. Purchase must be verified. Transitions inspection_status to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Fails if purchase not verified or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_cancel_application
description: Cancels SMAM application. Only when 'submitted' or 'under_review'. Requires session_token. Fails if already approved or purchase completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_raise_grievance
description: Raises SMAM grievance. Categories: 'application_rejected', 'vendor_issue', 'inspection_failure', 'subsidy_not_received', 'delay_in_processing'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: smam_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks SMAM grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
